brink: The company was on the brink of bankruptcy before the new manager arrived.
新经理到任之前,这家公司正处于破产的边缘。
preparatory: She took a preparatory course before applying to the university.
她在申请这所大学之前先修了一门预备课程。
artery: The doctor said the artery in his leg was blocked and needed treatment.
医生说他腿部的一条动脉堵塞了,需要治疗。
dutiful: He has been a dutiful son, visiting his parents every single weekend.
他一直是个尽职的儿子,每个周末都去看望父母。
deport: The government decided to deport the visitors who had entered the country illegally.
政府决定将那些非法入境者驱逐出境。
layman: The lecture was so clear that even a layman could understand the basic ideas.
这场讲座非常清楚,连外行都能听懂基本观点。
prophet: Long ago, people believed that a prophet could foretell the future of a nation.
很久以前,人们相信先知能够预言一个国家的未来。
bribe: The official was arrested for trying to bribe a police officer.
那名官员因试图贿赂一名警察而被捕。
decency: Out of common decency, she helped the old man carry his heavy bags.
出于基本的礼貌,她帮老人提起了沉重的行李。
falsehood: The report was based on complete falsehood and was quickly withdrawn.
这份报告完全基于谬误,很快就被撤回了。
gloom: A feeling of gloom spread through the office after the project was cancelled.
项目取消后,一种忧郁的情绪在办公室里蔓延开来。
prescient: Her prescient warning about the market saved us a lot of money.
她对市场有先见之明的警告为我们省了很多钱。
tuck: She tucked the letter into her pocket and hurried out of the house.
她把信塞进口袋,匆匆走出了房子。
brutal: The prisoners complained about the brutal treatment they received in the camp.
囚犯们抱怨他们在营地受到的残忍对待。
preclude: Poor health precluded him from joining the school football team.
身体不好使他无法加入学校足球队。
intricacy: Visitors admired the intricacy of the designs carved on the old wooden door.
游客们赞叹那扇旧木门上雕刻图案的错综复杂。
indignation: News of the unfair dismissal caused widespread indignation among the workers.
不公正解雇的消息在工人中引起了广泛的义愤。
reaffirm: The manager called a meeting to reaffirm the company's commitment to quality.
经理召集会议,重申公司对质量的承诺。
proximately: The two villages are proximately located, only a short walk apart.
这两个村子位置相近,步行片刻就能到达。
wildfire: The dry grass caught fire, and the wildfire spread across the hill quickly.
干草着了火,野火迅速蔓延到整个山坡。
rustle: I heard leaves rustle in the wind as I walked through the quiet park.
我走过安静的公园时,听到树叶在风中沙沙作响。
priceless: The museum keeps a priceless collection of ancient Chinese paintings.
这家博物馆收藏着一批无价的中国古代绘画。
honorary: The university awarded him an honorary degree for his lifetime of research.
这所大学因他毕生的研究授予他荣誉学位。
inexhaustible: She seems to have an inexhaustible supply of energy for her work.
她似乎有用不完的精力来投入工作。
overexcited: The children became overexcited and could not fall asleep after the party.
孩子们过于兴奋,聚会结束后无法入睡。
stockbroker: My stockbroker advised me to sell the shares before the price fell further.
我的股票经理人建议我在价格进一步下跌前卖出股票。
supervisor: Please report any problems with the equipment to your supervisor immediately.
设备如有任何问题,请立即报告给你的主管。
markedly: His English has improved markedly since he started reading every day.
自从他开始每天阅读以来,他的英语进步显著。
prematurely: The meeting ended prematurely because the power supply suddenly failed.
由于供电突然中断,会议提前结束了。
affiliation: The research center has a close affiliation with the local university.
该研究中心与当地大学有着密切的隶属关系。
revolutionize: The internet has revolutionized the way people communicate and shop.
互联网彻底改变了人们交流和购物的方式。
unintentionally: He unintentionally offended her by forgetting her name at the party.
他在聚会上无意间忘记了她的名字,冒犯了她。
violation: Parking here is a violation of the law, and you may get a fine.
在这里停车违反法律,你可能会被罚款。
preindustrial: Life in preindustrial villages was simple and centered around farming.
工业化以前村庄里的生活很简单,以农业为中心。
scarcity: The scarcity of clean water is a serious problem in many dry regions.
清洁水源的匮乏是许多干旱地区的严重问题。
misled: The unclear sign misled tourists, and many of them took the wrong road.
模糊的指示牌误导了游客,许多人走错了路。
recruiter: The recruiter invited her to an interview after reading her resume.
招聘者读完她的简历后邀请她去面试。
endorsement: The famous athlete's endorsement helped the new shoe sell very well.
那位著名运动员的代言帮助这款新鞋卖得非常好。
inaction: Their inaction during the crisis made the situation much worse.
他们在危机中的不作为使情况变得更加糟糕。
workload: She hired an assistant to help her manage the heavy workload.
她请了一位助手来帮她应付繁重的工作量。
